plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/backgrounds/room-51-tents.png, room-51 operation 3 over operation 2, derived and promoted by tools/art/interiors-plate.mjs at y 220; frame.json beside the candidate). Every rect below was read off that picture.
walkableNote: THE CAMP GROUND, from the fronts of the cabins and the grog tent out to the bank, and in front of the guyed tent's pegs. Stepped at the band edges the compiler slices it into (524, 607, 691), each step on the side of the edge that keeps the wider band (it samples a band's first and last rows), with level edges, so each band keeps its width (the ledge's lesson: a slanted edge is rasterised into inscribed bands and loses its corners): the bank down to the river cuts it off at the lower left in steps, and it reaches the foot of the path at the right.

scaling.note: ROOM 51'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad was painted about 347 tall (in plate pixels) with his feet at y 676; along Room 5's exterior slope (0.68 a row) that is 159 at y 400 and 471 at the bottom of the frame. The lookout, cut at the curve, stands 322 at y 640.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees, smallest first. THE TENTS is the guyed tent with the KNOCK board; THE GROG TENT, the big one with its flap tied back, is a way in; THE NOTICE is the stump and its paper.

THE PATH UP.note: Doc 109: the path back up the ravine to the ledge and the mine.

THE GROG TENT.note: Doc 109: the way in. Until G3 the lookout stops him, one line a time in order, then the third again (STOPPED BY THE LOOKOUT, counted in LOOKOUT_STOPS).

THE RIVER.note: Doc 109: the way down to the river. Until G3 the lookout stops him, as at the grog tent, on the same count.

obstacles.note: The ring of stones and the fire: he walks round it, in front or behind.
The stump: he walks round it in front. It stands at the walk's back edge, so no ground is kept behind it (a sliver there was a box nothing reached).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object is looked at on a bare click; every way walks.

figureLight.note: Errata 265 (Tyler, 2026-11-10, on the Gulch: "I defer to you"). In the Gulch's daylight Thad was the one cool, dark thing on a warm tan ground, apart from the Gulch's own men, who are painted in it. A warm light and nothing else: his coat stays blue and takes the sun.
